key_finding: Talen FY2025 delivered $1,035M adjusted EBITDA and $524M adjusted FCF on a 13.1 GW US generation portfolio anchored by the 2.5 GW Susquehanna nuclear facility (90% owned, generated ~17 TWh in 2025 at ~$27/MWh). The defining commercial milestone was the June 2025 expansion of the Amazon AWS PPA to up to 1,920 MW carbon-free baseload through 2042. Pending and recently closed acquisitions add ~5.3 GW of gas capacity for ~$7.25B total: Freedom + Guernsey (~$3.8B, closed in FY2025) and Cornerstone (~$3.45B, agreed). The financing stack is $1.4B 6.250% senior unsecured notes due 2034 plus $1.3B 6.500% senior unsecured notes due 2036, with management targeting net leverage around 3.5x or lower over the cycle.

amazon_aws_ppa.delivery_geography: Amazon data center campus adjacent to Susquehanna, plus other Pennsylvania sites
amazon_aws_ppa.additional_scope: Talen and Amazon also exploring co-development of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) within Talen's Pennsylvania footprint
amazon_aws_ppa.framing: Among the largest single carbon-free data center PPAs in US history; structurally similar to a multi-decade utility contract priced for AI workload buyers

capital_structure_target: Net leverage around 3.5x or lower over the cycle
market_position: Primarily operates in PJM (Mid-Atlantic, Ohio regions)
structural_observations: Susquehanna at ~$27/MWh LCOE is one of the most economic baseload assets on the PJM grid. The Amazon PPA monetises that LCOE at significantly higher contract prices for AI data center buyers.
Adjusted FCF of $524M against adjusted EBITDA of $1,035M produces an FCF/EBITDA ratio of 50% — strong cash conversion for an IPP with significant maintenance capex.
The PJM 2027/2028 capacity auction clearing price of $333.44/MW-day on 8,745 MW cleared implies ~$1.06B of annual capacity payments at that price level — adds substantial visibility to revenue.

$7.25B of total acquisition spend (Freedom + Guernsey + Cornerstone) against $2.7B of new debt issuance + adjusted FCF over multi-year horizon implies the company is meaningfully levering its balance sheet to consolidate gas capacity into the IPP fleet.
Brandon Shores + H.A. Wagner RMR contracts together provide $180M of fixed annual revenue through May 2029 — meaningful contribution to revenue stability.
